Entrepreneur · Ventures

Research that has to work outside the lab

For me, building a company is where research has to face the real world. I have co-founded three ventures, and before any of them I built NAAMII from scratch as a profit-not-distributing institute, which now has 52 full-time staff.

Co-founder & Chief Scientific Officer · 2024–

Tangible

Tangible is building the infrastructure for reorganizing work in the post-AI world. An organization is the set of processes it runs, and a step in a process can now be taken by a person or by an AI agent. Tangible models what each actor can do, and uses that model for personalized, problem-based learning and for helping organizations redesign how their work gets done.

My part is the science: I lead the research, supervise the AI researchers, and help our engineers work in an AI-native way. Tangible was incubated within NAAMII.

  • Personalized, problem-based learning
  • Competency-based skills assessment
  • Processes rehearsed alongside AI agents before they go live
  • Research published openly, starting with The AI Pyramid (2026)
Founder · built from scratch · 2018–

NAAMII

A research institute is a startup too. We structured NAAMII as a profit-not-distributing company so that it could earn, reinvest and outlive any single grant. Research becomes IP and talent, which then become either a spin-out or an R&D service for industry. It has grown to 52 full-time staff, with three deep-tech startups incubated to date.

Co-founder · 2020–

Diyo.ai

Conversational AI and speech technology for Nepali and other under-served languages, built on NAAMII’s language research. My role is an enabler in the ecosystem.

Co-founder & advisor · 2023–

Terahs

The engineering and infrastructure side of health imaging AI. It works alongside my research on AI for ultrasound and medical imaging.

The thread across all of them: talent in Nepal is not the constraint; structure is. I talked about this at the National Young Academy of Nepal in 2022, under the title “Incubating start-ups in (non-profit) research institutes in Nepal”. The NAAMII Innovation Factory is the next step: an attempt to make that structure repeatable. Read about it →
